update: Clarified the adjective's main semantic-predicate role in be + AdjP; added Chapter 6 pp. 526–527 sources and two examples.
Added Chapter 6 p. 527 source support for the absence of adverb predicative function; retained the existing engine scope.
Expanded the modifier category inventory to include prepositions and determinatives, preserving the caveat that not every adverb modifies every category.
Added Chapter 6 p. 527 source support for adjective-to-adverb -ly derivation.
Clarified the single AdjP level and recorded rare direct-NP complement uses of worth and like, with two exception examples and one ordinary PP example.
Clarified the single AdvP level and the qualified generalization that AdvP expansion is broadly a subset of AdjP expansion.
